title: Storage Virtualize RESTful API
items: What does the Storage Virtualize REST API consist of?
Command targets used to create, read, update, and delete system resources
REST API 由用來建立、讀取、更新與刪除系統資源的 Command Target 組成，參數原樣傳給 CLI 驗證。
Which protocol must be used to communicate with the RESTful API server?
必須使用 HTTPS 與 RESTful API Server 通訊。
How does the RESTful API provide security beyond HTTPS encryption?
By requiring command authentication with tokens
By requiring client certificates for every call
HTTPS 提供加密，REST API 另以 Token 驗證每個指令。
Which TCP port does the Storage Virtualize RESTful API always use?
Storage Virtualize RESTful API 的 Port 固定為 7443。
Which URL format is used for REST API command requests?
URL 格式為 https://system_ip:7443/rest/v1/command 或 .../rest/v1/target/ID。
To which node must REST API requests be directed?
The configuration node, through the system IP
請求須送到系統 IP，也就是 Configuration Node 所使用的位址。
For IBM Storage Virtualize for Public Cloud on AWS, what must be done before using the REST API?
Manually open TCP port 7443 in the AWS security group
AWS 上的 Public Cloud 版本需手動在 Security Group 開放 TCP 7443。
Which HTTP method does the Storage Virtualize REST API use?
REST API 只使用 HTTPS POST。
Why does the REST API use POST exclusively?
Command names (mk, ls, ch, rm) already express create, read, update, and delete, so HTTP methods are redundant
Command Target 以 Storage Virtualize 指令命名，mk、ls、ch、rm 已代表 CRUD，再用 HTTP 方法區分是多餘的。
Why doesn't the REST API use GET?
Most HTTP servers reject GET with body data, and query strings would need URL-encoded JSON
GET is not supported by HTTPS
多數 HTTP Server 拒絕帶 Body 的 GET，改用 Query String 需經兩次編碼，因此統一採用 POST。
How are positional and named parameters passed in REST API requests?
Positional parameters are appended to the URI; named parameters are sent as JSON in the request body
位置參數附加在 URI，具名參數以 JSON 放在 Request Body。
Where can you find REST API command target parameters?
參數說明可在 https://<system_ip>:7443/rest/explorer/ 的 OpenAPI Explorer 查詢。
What is the maximum number of requests per second to the auth endpoint?
auth Endpoint 每秒最多 3 個請求。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch25 Table 122
What is the maximum number of requests per second to command endpoints?
Command Endpoints 每秒最多 10 個請求。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch25 Table 122
What is the maximum number of active connections per RESTful API cluster?
每個 RESTful API Cluster 最多 40 個 Active Connection。
How many CLIs can be in progress simultaneously in the system?
系統同時進行中的 CLI 數量為 1。
簡報 S3；Concept Guide Ch25 Table 122
Which HTTP error code does the API return when a rate limit is reached?
達到速率上限時 API 回傳 HTTP 429。
Which header fields carry the username and password for authentication?
以 X-Auth-Username 與 X-Auth-Password 兩個 Header 提供帳密。
簡報 S5；Concept Guide Ch25 Authentication overview
A JWT (JSON Web Token) authentication token
POST 到 /auth 會回傳 JWT 驗證 Token，Token 內含到期時間。
Which header is used with the token for subsequent commands?
之後的命令以 X-Auth-Token Header 帶 JWT Token，取代每次輸入帳密。
What is the default token timeout?
Token 預設有效 1 小時 (60 分鐘)。
What is the configurable range for token expiry?
Token 到期可設定為 10 到 120 分鐘 (10 分鐘到 2 小時)。
Which HTTP code indicates loss of authorization when the token expires?
超過設定時間後回傳 403，表示失去授權，需再以 /auth 重新驗證。
Which commands view or change the token timeout?
以 `lssecurity` 或 `chsecurity` 檢視或變更 Token Timeout。
Does an unused token remain valid beyond the configured time?
No, it is authorized only for the configured time even if unused
Token 即使未使用，也只在設定時間內有效。
Concept Guide Ch25 API authentication management
Which algorithm is shown in the decoded JWT header example?
範例中解碼後的 JWT Header 為 typ JWT、alg HS512。
What format is the REST API response?
回應格式為 JSON，可用 Python 或 cURL 處理。
Which HTTP header is required to access a partition by using SNI?
以 SNI 存取 Partition 時，所有請求都需帶 X-Host Header。
How is the SNI value for a partition constructed?
The lowercase partition UUID formatted as <uuid>.fs.ibm.com
SNI 為小寫 Partition UUID 加上 .fs.ibm.com，也可在 GUI 的 Partition 檢視取得。
What HTTP code is returned if a request with X-Host is sent to a grid system not managing that partition?
若請求送到 Grid 內未管理該 Partition 的系統，會回傳 HTTP 308，引導 Client 到正確系統。
Which curl option follows redirects automatically?
使用 curl 時加 -L 自動跟隨重新導向；-k 為略過憑證驗證。
In Python requests, which setting follows redirect responses automatically?
Python 設定 allow_redirects=True 會自動跟隨 308 重新導向。
If allow_redirects is False and a 308 is returned, how do you find the redirect target?
停用自動導向時，可從回應的 Location Header 取得目標位址。
For redirection to work in a grid or HA configuration, what is required?
Both the request URL system and the redirect URL system must be active members of the same grid
Only the target must be in a grid
Neither must be in a grid
只有兩個系統都是同一 Grid 的作用中成員時，重新導向才會運作。
Which interface does the REST API replace for extracting performance statistics?
REST API 取代已停用的 CIM，用於取得效能統計。
CIM 是由 Distributed Management Task Force (DMTF) 制定的標準。
Why is REST preferred over CIM for newer systems?
It uses HTTP infrastructure with caches, proxies, and scalability, and is stateless
REST 善用 HTTP，具備 Cache、Proxy 與擴充性，且為 Stateless，操作簡單有效率。
Where are the XML performance statistics files stored?
效能統計 XML 檔存放於 Configuration Node 的 /dumps/iostats/。
Which REST endpoint lists the statistics files?
以 /lsdumps 列出檔案，搭配 prefix 參數指定 /dumps/iostats/。
Which REST endpoint downloads a statistics file?
以 /download 下載檔案，需提供 prefix 與 filename 參數。
How often are performance statistics usually updated by default?
統計通常約每 5 分鐘更新，可用 `chsystem` 設定、`lssystem` 檢視。
What is the statistics file naming format?
What does an error during a statistics file download usually mean?
The file was rotated; fetch the latest list and download again
下載出錯通常代表檔案已輪替，可重新取得最新清單再下載。
Which statistics file category is for volume groups?
Ng_stats 為 Volume Group；Nv 為 Volume、Nn 為 Node、Nm 為 MDisk、Nd 為 Drive。
Does the RESTful API server consider transport security itself?
No, it assumes requests come from a local, secured server; HTTPS provides privacy
Yes, it implements its own SSL
RESTful API Server 不處理傳輸安全，而是假設請求來自本地受保護的伺服器，由 HTTPS 提供加密。
Which programming tools are mentioned for listing and downloading performance data?
可使用 Python 或 Linux 的 cURL 等工具列出與下載效能資料。
How do you list the contents of /dumps/iostats/ with the REST API?
Use the prefix parameter in the /lsdumps request body
Use a GET request with a path
呼叫 /lsdumps 時於 Body 帶 prefix: /dumps/iostats/ 即可列出該目錄。
What is the first step to complete operations on the system by using the REST API?
Acquire a token by POSTing to /auth
先以帳密 POST 到 /auth 取得 Token，再以 X-Auth-Token 呼叫其他命令。
簡報 S4；Concept Guide Ch25 Authenticating
Which server name appears in the example REST API response header?
範例回應 Header 顯示 server: nginx，content-type 為 application/json。
When is the username and password required in a REST API session?
Only at the beginning of the session to obtain the token
只有在 Session 開始時需提供帳密，之後以 JWT Token 取代。
